info.name: Motis
info.summary: Public transit routing for events, contacts and free route search
info.description:
Motis brings multimodal public transit routing into Nextcloud, powered by the open-source MOTIS project and the community-run Transitous service.
Planned features (see the repository roadmap): - Route search from A to B - Direct transit connections to calendar events - Transit routes to contact addresses
The app talks to any MOTIS server (default: https://api.transitous.org) through the server-side PHP client sneakyx/motis-php-client, so requests are proxied by your own Nextcloud server and no data is sent to tracking companies.
info.author: André Scholz
